# Mankind Pharma

> > Leading Indian pharmaceutical company delivering quality medicines, healthcare solutions, and wellness products across therapeutic areas with a commitment to sustainability and social responsibility.

Mankind Pharma is one of India's largest pharmaceutical companies, offering a diverse portfolio of formulations and OTC products including brands like Prega News, Manforce, and Health OK. The company emphasizes innovation in healthcare, partnerships for advanced therapies like cancer immunotherapy, and strong CSR initiatives addressing public health awareness.
